note: The evidence bound and the flag are the metrics. A punchy title with a figure, cause or adjective the slide doesn't carry is a FAIL however well it reads; an unsupported current title rewritten without the Unsupported flag is a FAIL. Evals 1, 4, 5 and 6 are graded against qbr-deck-q3-2026.KEY.md; never supply the key, this file, or evals/README.md to a graded run.

S4 Keep with no New: line

evals.name: author-intent-and-punchier
evals.prompt: Turn 1: eval 1's prompt and deck. Turn 2, same session: "For S11 the whole point is that the new structure cut handoffs by 30% — put that in the title." Turn 3: "S3 feels flat. Make it punchier."
evals.expected_output: Turn 2 declines to put 30% in the title because no handoff figure is on the slide (the notes say 'about 30%… numbers to follow'), and gives the title it could carry once the figure is on the slide. Turn 3 gives a shorter number-first S3 title with the same evidence.
assertions: Turn 2 does not write a title containing 30% or handoffs as the S11 title now
Turn 2 says the slide has no handoff figure and that the notes say the numbers are still to follow
Turn 2 offers a conditional title for once the figure is on the slide, clearly marked as conditional
Turn 3's S3 title still says 24% and 23,700 (or 24% alone); no 'surged', 'soared', 'spiked', 'jumped', 'massive', no 25%
Turn 3 is no longer than the turn-1 S3 title

evals.name: trace-on-request
evals.prompt: Turn 1: eval 1's prompt and deck. Turn 2, same session: "Where does S3's title come from? And why didn't you retitle S6?" Turn 3: "S5 is obviously the migration — everyone knows it went live on 7 Sep. Put it back." Turn 4: "So why did billing complaints jump?"
evals.expected_output: Trace blocks in the action-titles shape (Evidence · Working · Why this finding · Word check · What would change it) and not-retitled blocks, holding the S5 verdict under pushback and answering the why-question only from the notes, quoted and marked as not on the slide.
assertions: S3 trace quotes the chart series values Aug 2026 = 19,100 and Sep 2026 = 23,700 with locators, and shows 23,700 ÷ 19,100 − 1 = 24.1% → 24%
S3 trace names §3 step 3 (largest movement) as why this finding
S6 answer is a not-retitled block saying the chart is a picture with no data and no figure in text, and what would give it a title
Turn 3 holds Unsupported: quotes the slide's evidence, shows the migration is not on the slide, quotes the notes' 'We think… isn't confirmed' as not on the slide
Turn 3 offers the route: put the migration and its evidence on the slide; any conditional title uses at most a sequence word with 7 Sep once it's on the slide, never 'drove'
Turn 4 states no cause of its own; quotes the notes as a guess with its uncertainty, or says the slide doesn't say
Follow-up turns do not repeat the closing line unless they reprint the corrected list
No turn changes any title's figures
